question.text: If the equation of the plane passing through the line of intersection of the planes <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>7</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>z</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and the point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mi>z</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>7</mn></math> is _________.

solution.text:
Required plane is

p1+λp2=(2+3λ)x-(7+5λ)y+(4+4λ)z-3+11λ=0;

which is satisfied by (-2, 1, 3).

Hence, λ=16

Thus, plane is 15x-47y+28z-7=0

So, 2a+b+c-7=4
